```text
FINDING 1
  location: Remarks section, second bullet ("What the choice cost is, and what it is not")
  severity: nonfatal
  claim: "Sierpiński proved, in ZF, that a function $\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ which is sequentially continuous at *every* point of $\mathbb{R}$ is continuous."
  evidence: The claim is mathematically false. In ZF the statement “every sequentially continuous function on $\mathbb{R}$ is continuous” is not provable; it is equivalent (over ZF) to a fragment of the Axiom of Choice (countable choice for subsets of $\mathbb{R}$, or full countable choice).  Sierpiński’s work showed equivalences of this kind – he did *not* prove the statement as a theorem of ZF.  The target’s own proof demonstrates that the pointwise converse uses countable choice, and the global statement similarly requires a choice principle.  The remark therefore asserts a falsehood.
```
